description_expanded:
Mala House | Inlet Beach, FL

38 Mala Way Inlet Beach, FL 32461

Mala House offers beautiful beach views of the emerald coast from the multiple balconies or third floor pool. This vacation rental home is pet friendly, has gulf views, has a private heated pool and offers 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms and can accommodate 14 guests.

The first floor of this home welcomes you with 14ft ceilings and a cozy living room space. The first bedroom has a king size bed and private bathroom. The next bedroom offers two queen size beds and has a loft. There is a full size bathroom on this floor.

The second floor treats you to the master bedroom which has a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and soaking tub. The next bedroom has a king size bed and shared access to the bathroom with the bunk room. The bunk room has a twin over twin, queen sleeper sofa, shared access to the bathroom, and gulf views from the balcony. There is a laundry room on this floor.

The third floor is the heart of the home. Enjoy beautiful views while preparing a meal in the gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances and ample amount of marble countertops. The stylish dining table can accommodate 8 guests. The living room provides comfortable seating while relaxing indoors. The third floor balcony has a private pool (that can be heated for $65/day). Whether you are in the pool or enjoying the balcony, the views of the white sandy beaches are unmatched!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Additional

- Pool: This home has a private pool. Seasonal pool heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. Pool heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

- Dog Friendly: Max weight of the dog is 40lbs. You must notify us of the breed and weight of dog. Pet cleaning fee of $250 applies

- Parking for 2 vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

-- Elevator usage is not available for guests unless it is needed by an elderly or handicapped individual. Please contact Dune Vacation Rentals prior to the arrival date for such arrangements.

- There is not an outlet on the exterior of the home - if a golf cart is rented during your stay, the only option to charge the cart would be to utilize the outlet in the front bedroom (queen room).

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
